Overview.Name: Divya Gayathri Akella
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & soya chunks curry & vegetable fry
Meal_2 (Dinner - lighter): Option 2: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & vegetable curry + curd

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid outside chat and pani puri regularly as they can worsen thyroid-related inflammation and cravings.
Start meals with paneer, curd or soya chunks before eating rice.
Keep meals simple and home-style instead of skipping meals and overeating later.
Maintain regular meal timings to improve energy and hormone balance.
During social gatherings, eat your regular meal first before outside snacks.
